hosy.source_location: Figure 3 legend and Materials and methods
hosy.replicate_unit: inside-out macropatches from Xenopus oocytes; n above bars
hosy.baseline_current_scope: Eight nucleotide-free mean currents and SEMs transcribed into katp_baseline_currents.csv; source attributes differences to oocyte variability and reports no construct-specific difference on the same day/batch.
hosy.digitization: Poppler pdfimages -all extracted the lossless raster; custom Python/NumPy/Pillow hosy_fig3I_digitize.py calibrated seven ticks and located stroke centres at half maximum.
hosy.license_evidence: PMC3904077.1 structured permission element, independently verified by submission-format agent on 2026-11-20.
hosy.readout_and_resolution: Fig. 3I: current in 300 uM MgADP / nucleotide-free current, -50 mV, inside-out oocyte macropatches. Raster resolution .0026 current-ratio units; .01 floor for inter-rendering scatter added in quadrature to SEM.

clatot.replicate_unit: Supplementary Table 1 labels n as number of experiments; Methods describe whole-cell patch-clamp recordings in HEK293 cells. Counts of independent transfections/days/batches per condition are not supplied.
clatot.R104W_lowest_fraction_evidence: Supplementary Table 1, PDF page 15: WT+R104W at column 0.1 is ND, defined in the heading as not done. S460A+R104W at column 0.1 has n=15 but no point is drawn; these are different cases.
clatot.digitization: Poppler pdftocairo -svg exported PDF vector paths; custom Python svg_paths.py and clatot_vector_extract.py calibrated six ticks and identified circle/square/triangle markers and error-bar segments; pdftoppm renders and clatot_overlay.py provide overlays.
clatot.fraction_design_evidence: Supplementary Table 1, PDF page 15, gives mutant input fractions 0,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,1; Supplementary Fig. 3A-B, PDF page 3, labels mixtures with matching percentages. These agree with Fig. 1c and Supplementary Fig. 3C positions. The text ratio labels are shorthand for the percentages; literal conversion is a sensitivity only. Input fractions are still proxies for assembly fractions.
clatot.unplotted_conditions: Supplementary Table 1 supplies recording counts only. At fraction .1, S460A+L325R has n=30 and S460A+R104W has n=15 but neither point is drawn. WT+R104W+difopein has a row of counts but no series in the digitized Fig. 1c or Supplementary Fig. 3C, so means/SEMs are unavailable for this inversion; no values are imputed.
clatot.definitions: Difopein inhibits 14-3-3 proteins. S460A is the NaV1.5 serine-to-alanine substitution at residue 460, disrupting the phosphoserine-dependent 14-3-3 interaction site (main Fig. 3 legend and Results).
clatot.readout_and_resolution: Fig. 1c and Supplementary Fig. 3C: peak current density at -20 mV / series WT or S460A endpoint. Vector resolution and numerical floor .0003 normalized-current units, added in quadrature to SEM.

tool_versions: Exact Poppler/Python package versions used in the original 8 November digitization were not recorded. Scripts and coordinate/error-bar extraction method are archived; later analysis dependencies are pinned separately.
scope: Overlays audit extracted points and error bars. No claim that the source plotted an incorrect trimer curve is needed for the reported inversion; source-model curves in this analysis are computed from their stated formulas.
unit_of_analysis: Recordings treated as independent; source SEMs treated as known error scales; no independent culture/day/batch hierarchy reconstructed.
